en: Black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic rural view of a village and farmland in a valley surrounded by low hills. In the foreground are fields with haystacks and a dirt road lined with stones or small standing rocks; farm buildings and industrial-looking structures are visible in the mid‑ground. The upper half of the postcard is filled with handwritten text in a Scandinavian language. The printed caption "ALVDAL" appears at the top left, and at the bottom right are the printed credits "Eneret Fot K Bredstrøm" and the reference "MINØ.38436".
